cur-fossil-flaming-cliffs.dateNote: On 13 July 1923 George Olsen of Roy Chapman Andrews' expedition found the first dinosaur eggs known to science here in the Gobi; the team had first reached the cliffs in 1922. Velociraptor and Protoceratops came from here too. The red sandstone is about 75–71 million years old (Late Cretaceous).
